maintenance_led.reason: Revenue is truckload freight transportation for shippers like FedEx, Walmart and Whirlpool, not repair or servicing of installed equipment.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are private shippers: consumer goods, food, retail and manufacturing companies paying for truckload freight.

serial_acquirer.reason: Mainly grows through its own trucking operations; it has made a few acquisitions (e.g., Millis, Smith, CFI) but not a steady roll-up.

mission_critical.reason: Truckload carriage is largely interchangeable; shippers can move freight to other carriers fairly easily, despite service awards.
